newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Motor Jan vehicle sales down 6.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Motor Jan vehicle sales down 6.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Daewoo Motor Co, a unit of the Daewoo Group, said on Tuesday its vehicle sales fell 6.2 percent to 45,914 units in January from 48,935 units a year ago.
The company's vehicle exports during the month dropped 4.9 percent to 23,019 units from 24,206 units a year ago.
Its domestic sales decreased 7.4 percent to 22,895 units from 24,729 units in January a year earlier, a company statement said.
The statement said the company's passenger car sales totalled 32,721 units in January, down from 41,162 units in January 1996.
